title: ProjektManga extension repository index
description: The generated index.json an app fetches to list what it can install. Written by build.mjs — never edited by hand. Readers must ignore unknown fields: new optional fields are added without bumping format_version.

format_version.description: Shape of this file. Bumped only for a change that would make an older reader misread it — a renamed field, a removed one, or one whose meaning changed. A reader should refuse a version above the one it knows.

name.description: Human name for this repository, shown wherever an installed source is attributed.

badge_label.description: Short chip shown next to sources from this repository.

contact.description: Where to report a broken source. Every value must be an https URL.

sources.description: One entry per installable source, sorted by source_key. Draft sources are absent.

source_key.description: Stable identity within this repository. The pair (repository, source_key) is what an installed source is keyed by.

version_code.description: major*1000000 + minor*1000 + patch. Compare this, don't parse the string: an update is available when this is greater than the installed one.

api_version.description: Extension contract the bundle implements. An app should skip a source whose api_version it does not support rather than install one it cannot drive.

entry_url.description: The single-file ES module to download and sandbox. Verify it against bundle.sha256 before running it.

icon_url.description: Optional. Absent when the source ships no icon — render a fallback rather than a broken image.

base_url.description: Where the source's own requests go.

homepage.description: Where to send a human. Equals base_url unless the source declared otherwise.

allowed_hosts.description: The hosts this source is permitted to reach, matched exactly or by suffix. The app enforces this; the listing carries it so a user can see it before installing.

content_rating.description: safe = no adult content; mixed = general catalogue that also carries adult titles, badge it rather than hiding it; nsfw = adult site.

isNSFW.description: True only when content_rating is "nsfw". Present so a reader that predates content_rating still behaves; prefer content_rating.

rate_limit_ms.description: Minimum milliseconds between this source's requests, which the app enforces outside the sandbox. Always written by build.mjs, defaulting to 1000. Optional here so an index built before this field existed still validates — a reader that finds it absent should apply its own conservative default rather than leaving the source unthrottled.

requires_browser_fetch.description: The source asks to be able to have pages loaded in a real browser with anti-detection applied, an elevated capability the app should surface to the user before installing. Always written by build.mjs. Treat absent as false.

referer.description: Optional. Referer to send when proxying this source's images; absent means fall back to homepage, then base_url.

bundle.description: Integrity for the file at entry_url. entry_url points at a mutable branch URL, so this is how a reader knows both that the bytes are the published ones and that they changed.

size.description: Bytes. Check it before reading the body to bound an unexpectedly large download.
